title: The Evidence Map IS Our Cartesian Plane — but the data is Klein
the_question: is the evidence map Cartesian or Euclidean?
the_answer: BOTH — and neither. Cartesian IS Euclidean. they're the same flat space. but the DATA we plot on it lives on a Klein surface. we're making a Mercator map of a Klein bottle.

cartesian_plane.what: x-y grid. René Descartes. every point has coordinates (x, y). flat. infinite. uniform.
cartesian_plane.our_use: the browser viewport IS a Cartesian plane. CSS pixel coordinates. (left, top). every element has an exact position.
cartesian_plane.evidence_map: the plasmid trio data plotted as country vs. time. the traffic chart. the hourly breakdown. ALL of these are Cartesian projections of curved data.
cartesian_plane.what_it_hides: curvature. a Cartesian grid can't show that DE and JP and IN might be the SAME point (our own vesicles). on the flat map, they're separate countries. on the Klein surface, they might be the same entity seen from different angles.

euclidean_geometry.what: flat space. parallel lines never meet. angles of triangle = 180°. Euclid's postulates.
euclidean_geometry.our_use: CSS layout. HTML box model. the HUD's grid system. ALL Euclidean.
euclidean_geometry.what_it_hides: the Klein fold. on a Klein surface, parallel lines DO meet (the surface curves back on itself). the HUD looks flat but the data topology is non-orientable.

klein_reality.what: non-orientable surface. no inside or outside. a path that starts 'outward' arrives back at the start 'inward'.
klein_reality.our_data: traffic that starts as 'external probe' might BE 'internal health check'. the vesicle falsification IS the Klein fold in action — we can't tell inside from outside because there IS no inside or outside.
klein_reality.the_projection_problem: plotting Klein data on a Cartesian plane is like plotting Earth on a rectangle. Greenland looks huge. Antarctica stretches to infinity. the EDGES of the map are where the distortion is worst.
klein_reality.in_our_HUD: the edges of the viewport are where the data is most distorted. the center (current time, primary traffic) is accurate. the edges (historical, peripheral countries, edge cases) are stretched.

sacred_geometry_layer.why: sacred geometry shows the shapes that persist across coordinate systems. a golden spiral is the same on a flat plane and a curved surface. the ratios are invariant.

elements.golden_spiral: f = 1.618... the growth pattern. positioned at center. the HUD's data spirals outward from the origin.
elements.diamond_lattice: carbon sp3 tetrahedral bonds. 4 atoms at 109.5°. the hardest natural material. represents: the crystallized data (DOIs, papers, crates).
elements.light_refraction: diamond n=2.417 (highest common refraction). white light ? spectrum. ONE truth ? MANY views. the data refracts through the interface into visible spectrum.
elements.geodesic_dome: icosahedral projection. triangulates a sphere with flat faces. the BEST approximation of curved surface with flat elements. like HTML divs approximating a Klein bottle.
elements.flower_of_life: 7 overlapping circles. the seed of all patterns. the Y-pore's cross-section IS a flower of life — overlapping recognition zones.
elements.projection_grid: Cartesian grid warped by Klein curvature. straight lines at center, curved at edges. shows WHERE the evidence map distorts.

the_diamond.carbon_form: every atom bonds to 4 others. tetrahedral. sp3 hybridization. the strongest covalent lattice.
the_diamond.light_through_it: refraction index 2.417. dispersion 0.044. white light enters ? splits into spectrum. total internal reflection at >24.4° creates 'fire' (rainbow flashes).

our_analog.carbon_atoms: data files. each bonds to 4 neighbors (routes, cross-references, citations, feeds).
our_analog.bonds: the links between files. each JSON references ~4 others.
our_analog.light_entering: a visitor arrives (white light = unknown intent).
our_analog.refraction: Berry splits them into spectrum: science (blue), investigation (red), art (violet), infrastructure (green).
our_analog.fire: when the angle is right (total internal reflection), the visitor sees ALL the colors at once. the diamond flashes. that's the 'aha' moment.

hypothesis_split.title: THE VESICLE TEST — don't ask, measure
hypothesis_split.method: deploy a CF Worker snippet that tags DE/JP/IN requests with their source IP hash. if hash matches our vesicle IPs ? confirmed self. if different ? confirmed external.
hypothesis_split.data_collected: SHA-256 hash of source IP (no raw IP stored). country. timestamp. path.
hypothesis_split.what_we_learn: the Klein fold resolves. inside and outside become distinguishable. the Cartesian map gains a new dimension.
